title: Grateful Dead Live at Seminole Indian Village on 1969-05-24

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a rare 1969 Miami show that sounds decent but has cuts and pitch wobble, highlighted by an early jam and solid China Cat/Eleven amid uneven performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is a sound‑board source that generally holds up, though listeners note a 36‑second cut and a brief pitch slowdown. Musically the concert starts strong with an inspired first jam and a good run through China Cat into The Eleven, but later songs lose tempo and the drums feel disconnected, giving the show an overall average to below‑average vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Two enthusiastic 5‑star reviews are offset by a detailed 3‑star critique that calls the show average and points out recording glitches; weighted averaging of show (≈2.5) and recording (≈3) yields a low‑mid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear but includes a 36 sec cut, a pitch slowdown of about –2% on a solo, and occasional missing seconds; overall listenable despite these issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early jam and solid middle section, then the performance drifts with sloppy tempos and weak drum interplay.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Brief unique jam around 13:45 noted; also his spoken intro at the end of "And We Bid You Goodnight" is mentioned.
band_member_comments.Drums: Described as 'shoes in the dryer' with little cohesion or interplay.
